question.text: Gold is generally regarded as a hedge against:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, gold is regarded as a hedge against inflation — investors tend to invest in gold when inflation rates move up. The Trap: Gold is not described in the workbook as a deflation hedge. Currency appreciation tends to make imported gold cheaper domestically, not more attractive as a hedge. The "inflation hedge" framing is the specific descriptor used in the workbook. Note: The workbook's framing here is inflation specifically; broader portfolio-allocation prescriptions or correlation figures are not supported on the cited page.
